issues.title: Jordan church attack survivor says her cousin died before her eyes
issues.title_en: Jordan church attack survivor says her cousin died before her eyes
issues.summary: By AbdelHadi Ramahi HAMOUD, Jordan, Oct 25 (Reuters) - When gunmen began opening fire on a church in Jordan,Sahar al-Halsa hid behind a pillar as she heard the shooting and people screamed in panic during a funeral service for her cousin's daughter. When she rushed outside in the chaos, she said she spotted the assailants and another cousin lying on the ground wounded. "I went to him and said: 'Assem, Assem, my darling, answer me'," she said. She said he opened his eyes to look at her, but then "he was gone".
